name: __vfptr
meaning: Holds the vtable: delete, evaluate, verify, store

name: m_link
meaning: Holds the property's link in the update list

name: m_type
meaning: Holds the property type: 3 vector, 6 scalar or angle in the camera

name: m_flags
meaning: Holds 0x01 listed, 0x02 verify only, 0x04 stale, 0x08 changed

name: m_producer
meaning: Holds the callback evaluate and verify run, or null

name: m_producerContext
meaning: Holds the value passed to the producer in ecx

name: m_orderKey
meaning: Holds the key that orders the update list

name: __vfptr
meaning: Holds the vtable 0x81d7c0

name: m_slotCapacity
meaning: Holds the allocated length of the slot array

name: m_slotCount
meaning: Holds the number of slots; ids at or past it are refused

name: m_slots
meaning: Holds the property pointer for each id

name: m_listLinkOffset
meaning: Holds 4, the offset of the link inside a listed property

name: m_listHead
meaning: Holds the update list head, linked to itself when empty

name: m_eyeProperty
meaning: Holds the eye position property, id 7, a vector

name: m_eye
meaning: Holds the eye position

name: m_targetProperty
meaning: Holds the point looked at property, id 8, a vector

name: m_target
meaning: Holds the point looked at

name: m_distanceProperty
meaning: Holds the eye-to-target distance property, id 1, a scalar

name: m_distance
meaning: Holds the eye-to-target distance

name: m_farClipProperty
meaning: Holds the far clip distance property, id 2, a scalar

name: m_farClip
meaning: Holds the far clip distance

name: m_nearClipProperty
meaning: Holds the near clip distance property, id 3, a scalar

name: m_nearClip
meaning: Holds the near clip distance

name: m_pitchProperty
meaning: Holds the pitch angle property, id 0, a angle

name: m_pitch
meaning: Holds the pitch angle

name: m_pitchCos
meaning: Holds the cosine of the pitch angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_pitchSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the pitch angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_fovProperty
meaning: Holds the field of view property, id 4, a angle

name: m_fov
meaning: Holds the field of view

name: m_fovCos
meaning: Holds the cosine of the field of view, recomputed on every store

name: m_fovSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the field of view, recomputed on every store

name: m_rollProperty
meaning: Holds the roll angle property, id 5, a angle

name: m_roll
meaning: Holds the roll angle

name: m_rollCos
meaning: Holds the cosine of the roll angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_rollSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the roll angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_yawProperty
meaning: Holds the yaw angle property, id 6, a angle

name: m_yaw
meaning: Holds the yaw angle

name: m_yawCos
meaning: Holds the cosine of the yaw angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_yawSin
meaning: Holds the sine of the yaw angle, recomputed on every store

name: m_createTime
meaning: Holds the client clock when the object was built

name: m_held
meaning: Holds the held command bits; 0x1 and 0x2 are the two primary mouse commands

name: m_travelX
meaning: Holds the sum of scaled |dx| since the first primary press

name: m_travelY
meaning: Holds the sum of scaled |dy| since the first primary press

name: m_motionStamp
meaning: Holds a graphics device counter read at the last mouse motion while a command was held

name: m_pressTime
meaning: Holds the clock time of the first primary press

name: m_clickMode
meaning: Holds the armed click action, 1 or 2, set to 0 when a release is a drag

name: m_accumulator
meaning: Holds the sum the advance returns; the seed after seeding

name: m_lanes
meaning: Holds four lane indices, byte k a byte offset into the table
